# Doomstack

> Your altitude is permanent. The ground rises instead. The price of #1 falls with every
> thousand views — until someone buys it.

Doomstack is a browser game plus a set of paid category leaderboards ("stacks"). The free
climb is a skill-based endless climber with one global leaderboard and no payment. The paid
stacks are 74 category leaderboards where players buy permanent altitude and compete to avoid
being buried as the ground rises; each has its own season, rate, and standings.

## Primary pages

- https://www.doomstack.lol/ — landing page, category directory, free-climb leaderboard preview
- https://www.doomstack.lol/climb — the free climb leaderboard
- https://www.doomstack.lol/play — play the free climb
- https://www.doomstack.lol/rules — the exact growth, burial, and season formulas
- https://www.doomstack.lol/stack/{category} — one of 74 paid category leaderboards
- https://www.doomstack.lol/b/{slug} — a permanent record page for one submitted block
